physicalNotes: Radius 1.425 +/- 0.048 solar radii from Barone et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 28109 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A..41B/abstract): 991,373 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
